t:
In a reinsurance contract, insurable interest is vested in the:-

I. Reinsurer
II. Reinsured
III. Insurance broker
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
With regard to property insurance, claim ratio depends upon:-

I. The number of individual risks constituting the portfolio
II. The standard deviation
III. The ratio of probable maximum loss by one event to the premium of the portfolio
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: This arises when the actual premium awaits the outcome of the completion of the treaty or contract period:-
e: Correct answer: Deposit premium (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Aggregate Excess of loss reinsurance is on the similar lines as _______________ reinsurance.
e: Correct answer: Excess of loss (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following approach/es to self insurance often do not find legal and / or regulatory sanction in most countries?

I. As a retained level of deductible
II. Through a mutual group or pool within an association or body to share retained risk
III. As a fund constituted to address a loss if it were to occur
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Most intermediary clauses shift all credit risk to reinsurers by providing that:-

I. The ceding insurer`s payments to the intermediary be deemed payments to the reinsurer.
II. The reinsurer's payments to the intermediary are not payments to the ceding insurer until actually received by him.
III. Credit risk cannot be shifted to reinsurers.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following arrangement is useful in widely dispersed risks such as in agriculture exposed to pest damage?
e: Correct answer: Stop loss ratio (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Where the insurers have a common management or common ownership they may resort to _________.
e: Correct answer: Group reinsurance (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the people that are within the insurer who are interested in financial information.

I. Shareholders
II. Management
III. Employees
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: An insurer cedes 90% of the risk and retains 10%. If the sum insured is Rs. 50,000, then how much will be retained by the insurer?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 5,000 (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Commodity price fluctuation is an example of ____________.
e: Correct answer: Financial risk (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following zones are highly exposed to Tropical Cyclones?

I. East Coast of U.S.A.
II. Central America
III. Caribbean
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In India, in _______ during the nationalisation of general insurance, all general insurance companies were reconstituted into four companies.
e: Correct answer: 1973 (from the IC85 question bank).

t: An insurer cedes 90% of the risk and retains 10%. If the sum insured is Rs. 50,000, then how much will be ceded by the insurer?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 45,000 (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _____________ is an agreement to an exchange of risk under different terms.
e: Correct answer: Swap (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In case of proportional treaty reinsurance, because of the nature of business involved, _________ treaties  usually have 'worldwide' scope.
e: Correct answer: Marine (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ____________ should be low enough as not to be involved in the majority of the claims and yet high enough to keep the insurer from being too greatly exposed in any one loss.
e: Correct answer: Reinsured's retention (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In 1966, the Indian Insurance Companies Association initiated the formation for Reinsurance Pools in ________ to increase the retained premiums in the country.

I. Marine Insurance
II. Fire and Hull Insurance
III. Health Insurance
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In surplus method of reinsurance, who decides the limit of liability which can be retained on any one risk or class of risk?

I. Intermediary
II. Ceding insurer
III. Reinsurer
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _________ can be a retained level of deductible.
e: Correct answer: Self insurance (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Adverse situations arise when substantial gross payments need to be made immediately in respect of risks which are retained marginally. To eliminate the strain arising from this aspect on invested funds which facility is administered in all outward arrangements?

I. Net account facility
II. Cash loss recovery facility
III. Theoretical accumulation of net losses facility
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is an example of alternative carrier in UK?

I. Market Terrorism pool
II. Pool Re
III. GIC Re
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Complicated legal liability claims is an example of _______________.
e: Correct answer: IBNR losses (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following statement is correct with regard to Currency clause?
o: For the purpose of accounting of various foreign currencies, ceding insurers adopt rates of exchange as at the beginning of the year
Deals comprehensively with all aspects of losses a
The salient features are the possibility of making
Is usually included in a reinsurance agreement whe
Give the reinsurer the right to inspect any book o
e: Correct answer: For the purpose of accounting of various foreign currencies, ceding insurers adopt rates of exchange as at the beginning of the year (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Working Excess of loss reinsurance:-

I. Is intended to limit losses that arise on the reinsured's day-to-day operations
II. Caters to the reinsured's need for protection against number of losses that arise out of a single accident
III. Can be effective for reinsurance of legal liabilities to third parties
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the zones that are highly exposed to earthquake.

I. East Coast of U.S.A.
II. Central America
III. Caribbean Islands
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following methods, is used to avoid the hazard of the reinsurer cancelling a contract and leaving the insurer without cover for the duration of the policies?

I. Losses occurring basis
II. Risk attaching basis
III. Premium basis
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
When reinsuring facultatively, the insurer obtains reinsurance coverage before accepting to insure a client. This is done:-

I. To ensure that the reinsurance terms do not exceed those applying to the direct insurance
II. To back up the judgment of the original underwriter at the insurer's office
III. To add cushion to the insurer's already exhausted solvency margins
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
As per market practice an intermediary issues a cover note. What is included in a cover note?

I. The terms of placement
II. Premium
III. The participating underwriters with their shares set opposite their names
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ABC Insurance Co. has fixed its retention limit at Rs. 10,00,000. It has insured a risk of Rs. 1,00,00,000. On the basis of sum insured the percentage of retention and surplus are 10% and 90%. The PML is estimated at 25% of the sum insured. On the basis of PML what will be the surplus (percentabe of PML) for the insurer?
e: Correct answer: 60% (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is a regional reinsurance pool?

I. Asian Reinsurance Corporation
II. African Reinsurance Corporation
III. WTO
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In 1961, the Government of India made it compulsory by statute on the part of every insurer to cede ________ in Credit and Solvency Business.
e: Correct answer: 5% (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Retentions are expressed in terms of _______________.
e: Correct answer: Sum insured (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following investment/s are used to leverage capital gain for a better return from the investment portfolio?

I. Long term investments
II. Stock market investments
III. Investments in liquid assets
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Net retained lines clause:-

I. Allows the ceding insurer to effect other reinsurances in priority so that there is an additional treaty which protects the net account only
II. Will normally be omitted where the treaty covers the reinsured's gross account or where the cover operates for common account
III. The insolvency clause usually forms a part of this clause
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to risk retention financing.

I. Asset management plays a central role in risk transfer and risk retention financing.
II. The time value of money can have a considerable influence on premium.
III. In the case of finite risk reinsurance the anticipated investment income is expressly acknowledged as an underwriting component.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the relevant factor/s from following which is relevant in reinsurance programme design, with regard to decision making on what type of reinsurance arrangements are most suitable?

I. Paid up capital
II. Risk based capital
III. Size and structure of portfolio
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Lloyd's aviation underwriters have the knowledge and ability to insure which of the following risks?

I. Product liability for aircraft manufacturers
II. Airport risks
III. Business aircraft
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
What are the salient features of Alteration clause?

I. Possibility of making amendments
II. Consent of both the parties
III. Addendum forming integral part of and binding on the parties
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following clause specifies the reinsurer's limit of liability?
o: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proporti
Net retained lines: Protecting net retention
e: Correct answer: Business Covered: Insuring clause non-proportional (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to treaty wordings.

I. The general conditions are normally the same for all classes of insurance business.
II. The special conditions are specific to each class and type of contract.
III. Treaty wordings for proportional and non-proportional forms of reinsurance are same.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following statement is correct with regard to Errors and omissions clause?
o: Expects immediate rectification and nothing in the clause would operate to increase the liability of the reinsurers beyond agreed limits
Deals with the commencement of reinsurance and the
The salient features are the possibility of making
Is usually included in a reinsurance agreement whe
Give the reinsurer the right to inspect any book o
e: Correct answer: Expects immediate rectification and nothing in the clause would operate to increase the liability of the reinsurers beyond agreed limits (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _________________ is the reinsurer of last resort for Pool Re, protecting it in the event that Pool Re exhausts its financial resources following claims payments.
e: Correct answer: U.K Treasury (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Under _____________, a `Two Risk Warranty` is included within the contract to denote minimum accumulation from two risks.
e: Correct answer: Catastrophe XL covers (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In credit rating, the analytical process in evaluation by an agency incorporates:-

I. Comparisons to peers
II. Comparisons to industry standards
III. Assessments of reinsurer's operating plans, philosophy and management
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. Stock market investments are used to leverage capital gain for a better return from the investment portfolio.
II. Investment in the stock market decreases the Cost of administration and Exposure to capital loss.
III. Investments of a long term nature helps in increasing liquidity.
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t: What is the principal object of the WTO?
o: To assist the respective governments in setting up
To accept reinsurance and retrocession business fr
To actively promote free trade in services
To provide political risk insurance (guarantees) t
To promote regional pools supporting the countries
e: Correct answer: To actively promote free trade in services (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
When two reinsurance companies get into a contract, it is known as _________.

I. Facultative reinsurance
II. Treaty reinsurance
III. Retrocession
IV. Facultative obligatory reinsurance
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
What is the obligation of a reinsurer when the ceding insurer is in financial difficulties or is insolvent?

I. Reinsurer shares insurance fate, hence reinsurer will have to pay full share of the loss
II. Reinsurer shares commercial fate, hence reinsurer will have to pay full share of the loss
III. Reinsurer shares insurance fate, hence the reinsurer will not have to pay his share of the loss
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In treaty reinsurance, a formal treaty wording is usually drawn up by the parties to describe: -

I. Monetary limits
II. Mode of operation
III. Classes of business covered
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).
